scores.visual_critic_note: Pleasantly earthy color palette and clean button controls show design intent, but the always-visible FPS counter is debug UI, the credits section adds unnecessary chrome, and the visualization is clipped mid-render in the screenshot suggesting the 900×900 SVG overflows the viewport without scroll accommodation.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Correct scaleSqrt for force-layout area encoding and data-driven domains via d3.extent/root.height, but hierarchyLinkSelection lacks a key function and the partition layout's sqrt-scaled y-axis subtly distorts depth-proportional area.
scores.stress_test_note: Easing-param sliders fire updateLayout() (full 1500ms transition) on every input event with no throttle or debounce, and no .interrupt() is called before new transitions begin, leaving current_x/current_y unsynchronised when the 'end' handler is skipped on interruption.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Single-view design with strong hover/click focus interaction manages the 300-link density well, but the default unfiltered state at low curve tension (8%) creates a dense crossing tangle at the hierarchy root that overwhelms before interaction kicks in; animation quality across 200+ nodes and 8 layout modes cannot be assessed from a static screenshot.

proposer: Replaced the if/else chain for target position calculation with a lookup object, hoisted `noTransformPrev` out of the per-node loop, and shared the polar coordinate function between radial and cluster layouts. Net reduction: ~6 lines.
